2026-w1-sat-deadline.text:
Week 1 Sunday is tomorrow. Wednesday and Thursday are already in the books — if your pool locks at 1 PM ET, that's the real deadline.

Your top confidence points belong on the games you'd feel dumb missing, not the ones you're excited about.

blitz-odds.com

2026-w1-sun-live.text:
Kickoff in a few hours. Every game card has live score, down and distance, and last play once it starts — tap the bell on any game to get a push when it goes final.

blitz-odds.com

2026-w1-mon-grading.text:
New this week: the league My Picks tab grades every pick the moment a game goes final. Score, winner, Won/Lost per game, and your week record in the header.

Monday night is the last one to land. Check it after.

blitz-odds.com

2026-w2-tue-lines-up.text:
Week 2 lines are up. Lions at Bills opens it Thursday night — BUF -4.5, O/U 53.5, highest total on the board.

Same reminder as last week: if your pool locks at first kickoff, that's Thursday, not Sunday.

Full Week 2 confidence order: blitz-odds.com

2026-w2-wed-biggest-spreads.text:
Week 2's biggest spreads as of Wednesday:

MIA at SF — SF -13.5
CLE at TB — TB -8.5
NO at BAL — BAL -8.5
LV at LAC — LAC -7

That's the top of your confidence sheet. The question is the order — and the model doesn't always agree with the spread.

blitz-odds.com

2026-w2-thu-tnf-coinflips.text:
Lions at Bills tonight, 8:15 PM ET on Prime Video.

The three closest Sunday games right now:
CAR at ATL — CAR -2.5
JAX at DEN — DEN -2.5
CIN at HOU — HOU -3

Coin flips. In a confidence pool, those are your 1s, 2s and 3s.

2026-w2-fri-one-data-point.text:
One week of results is one data point.

The team that looked awful in Week 1 is still the roster the market liked in August. Lines move a point or two, not seven. Don't let one Sunday flip your whole confidence sheet.

blitz-odds.com

2026-w2-sat-survivor.text:
Survivor players: Week 2 has three favorites of 7.5 or more. Tempting.

Before you burn SF or TB, look at who's still available to you in Week 5 and Week 8. The survivor path planner in the Playbook tab maps it out.
